en.summary: Kidney infection often causes fever, flank/back pain, nausea and urinary symptoms. NHS: needs prompt medical assessment and prescribed antibiotics — never invent doses. Emergency: confusion, very high fever, vomiting preventing pills, pregnancy with fever/flank pain, or low blood pressure signs.
emergencyIf: Confusion or very high fever with shaking
Pregnant with fever and flank pain
Signs of sepsis (extreme weakness, mottled skin)
seeDoctorIf: Fever with flank pain or UTI symptoms lasting
doNot: Do not delay care for fever with flank pain

fr.summary: Pyélonéphrite: fièvre, douleur de flanc. Avis médical rapide; pas d'antibiotiques inventés. Urgences si sepsis, grossesse fébrile, vomissements.
emergencyIf: Grossesse avec fièvre et douleur de flanc

he.summary: דלקת כליות: חום וכאב מותן. הערכה דחופה; אין אנטיביוטיקה מומצאת. חירום באלח דם, הריון עם חום, הקאות.

ru.summary: Пиелонефрит: лихорадка, боль в боку. Срочная оценка; антибиотики не выдумывать. Неотложка при сепсисе, беременности с лихорадкой, рвоте.
emergencyIf: Беременность с лихорадкой и болью в боку
